name: earliest
about: Like the Earliest Text: sense lines, §¶ and ¶ starting sense blocks

rows.text: §¶I the miller having been born by the river,/therefore I learned somewhat of the wheel./And having seen many floods in my days,/I make a record of the mill.
/Yea, I make a record in the words of my father.
¶For it came to pass in the first year/of the new wheel/—my father having kept the mill all his days—/that the river rose.
